references.title: DWDS: Herr
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; sense 3 'jmd., der anderen zu befehlen hat, Gebieter'. Etymologie: ahd. hēriro, hērro, inherited, not built in German

references.title: en.wiktionary: Herr
references.supports: German etymology: inherited from MHG hērre, OHG hēriro, originally a comparative of OHG hēr (whence hehr)

notes.rationale: der gnädige Herr, the master of the house in a servant's mouth (DWDS sense 3). DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, and the old comparative of hehr is inherited, not a German formation, so it is a bottom word: the Root herr and the zero ending (ADR 0051).
